usdRate.sourceName: Banque de la République du Burundi, daily exchange rates, US dollar mid rate, 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: Mid rate 3,013.13 francs per dollar (buying 2,989.03, selling 3,037.24); World Bank 2025 average 2,943. CLDR gives 'BIF' as symbol; 'FBu' is the local abbreviation used for the franc burundais.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing the national statistics institute (ISTEEBU/INSBU), consumer prices, September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source: the statistics office site could not be read. Annual inflation 7.4% in September 2026 (8.4% in August), the lowest since May 2021; food inflation 1.7%. The BRB's CPI table (INSBU data) confirms 8.4% for August 2026. Inflation averaged 34% in 2025 (World Bank) and peaked at 45.5% in April 2025.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BRB monetary policy report Q4 2025 (inflation outlook); World Bank CPI inflation 2021-2025
inflation_projection.note: Inflation averaged about 22% a year over 2021-2025 and has only just fallen to 7.4%, with no formal target and a wide parallel-market exchange premium, so 12% a year is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: Banque de la République du Burundi (BRB), monetary policy report Q4 2025: policy rate cut from 12% to 10%
policy_rate.note: Cut by 200 basis points at the 26 February 2026 monetary policy committee; the BRB website still showed 10% 'in effect since 26/02/2026' on 31 October 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: BRB, monetary policy report Q4 2025, table 11: weighted average rate on passbook savings accounts (comptes sur livrets), end-December 2025
savings_account_rate.note: Weighted average on outstanding passbook savings at banks, 4.97% at end-December 2025 (4.90% end-September). Latest published quarter found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: The BRB publishes one weighted average for all term deposits (7.44% at end-December 2025), not by maturity; no 3-month figure was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: BRB, monetary policy report Q4 2025, table 11: weighted average rate on term deposits (dépôts à terme), end-December 2025
fdr_1y_rate.note: Average over all term-deposit maturities (not 1 year only), 7.44% at end-December 2025, unchanged from September 2025.

dps_rate.note: No industry-wide rate for a monthly recurring deposit product was found in BRB statistics.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: BRB, monetary policy report Q4 2025, table 11: overall weighted average deposit rate (taux moyen pondéré créditeur), end-December 2025
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average on outstanding deposits: 7.15% at end-December 2025 (demand 3.35%, passbook 4.97%, term 7.44%).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; Treasury bills and bonds are auctioned by the BRB.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: BRB, Treasury bill auction results of 28-29 October 2026, 91 days
tbill_91d_rate.note: Weighted average rate 8.89% on the 91-day bill (182 days 9.40%, 364 days 11.00%).

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: BRB, Treasury bond auction results of 29 June 2026, 5 years
tbond_5y_rate.note: Weighted average 9.67% at the last 5-year auction found (a single bid of 1 billion BIF); the 2-year bond is auctioned weekly at about 14.1%, so the curve is irregular.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: BRB, Treasury bond auction results of 28-29 October 2026, 10 years
tbond_10y_rate.note: Weighted average 11.46% at the 10-year auction of 28 October 2026 (10.97% on 20 October).

tax_bank_interest.note: The withholding tax on interest (impôt sur les revenus des capitaux mobiliers) could not be confirmed: the revenue authority (OBR) site returned an error and PwC Tax Summaries has no Burundi page.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No savings certificate exists and the tax on Treasury-security interest for individuals could not be confirmed from an official source.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No published deposit-guarantee cover per depositor was found; the deposit guarantee fund's site could not be reached.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published card rate was found; the BRB reports average short-term lending rates of 15.75% (end-December 2025).

equity_return_low.sourceName: BRB Treasury auctions (364-day bill 11.00%); no local stock exchange
equity_return_low.note: Low case: no local stock market, so a global index held in francs; a weak decade for world shares with a stable official rate gives about 4%.

equity_return_base.sourceName: BRB term-deposit average 7.44% (Q4 2025), about 6.5% after an assumed withholding tax
equity_return_base.note: Base case: no local stock exchange operates, so this is a global equity index in Burundian-franc terms, held to 4 points above the after-tax deposit rate (6.5%).

equity_return_high.sourceName: BRB official exchange rate history; World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF
equity_return_high.note: High case: global shares near their long-run dollar return plus continued franc depreciation (the official rate moved from about 2,000 to 3,000 per dollar in 2021-2026).

gold_return_low.sourceName: BRB official exchange rate, 3,013 BIF per dollar (30 October 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with modest franc depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BRB official exchange rate history; World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold trend of about 4-5% a year plus expected franc depreciation of about 5% a year.

gold_return_high.sourceName: BRB official exchange rate history; World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold and a further devaluation such as the 2023 step from about 2,070 to 2,850 per dollar.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: passbook savings rate, about 5%, with tax uncertain.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: slightly below the term-deposit average to allow for withholding tax that could not be confirmed.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: one-year Treasury bills at about 11% less some tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found; the insurance regulator (ARCA) site was unavailable.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term-life premium rates per 1,000 BIF of cover were found from the regulator or another public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums per 100,000 BIF of cover were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS
oop_health_share.note: 24.5% in 2023 (latest year; older than 2025). External donors finance a large share of health spending.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: BRB statistics table V.7, consumer price index by function (INSBU data), health and general indices 2018-2026
goal_inflation_health.note: The health index rose about 17% a year over 2020-2025 against 21% for all items (13% vs 17% over 2018-2025), so health costs are planned at about 80% of the 12% general assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: BRB statistics table V.7, consumer price index by function (INSBU data), education and general indices 2018-2026
goal_inflation_education.note: The education index rose about 7% a year over 2020-2025 against 21% for all items (1.5% in the year to August 2026), so education costs are planned at half the 12% general assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 (medium variant) for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 4.77 (2025, World Bank), 5.1 (2040) and 9.0 (2065, populationpyramid.net/burundi/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The pension age of the private-sector scheme (INSS) could not be read from an official source: the INSS site did not respond and ILO and SSA country pages refused access.

retirement_age_government.note: The retirement age of civil servants (ONPR scheme) could not be confirmed from an official text that could be read.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: passbook savings rate in retirement.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case: below the term-deposit average to allow for withholding tax, so not above the after-tax safe rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: rolling short Treasury bills at about 9% less some tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly deposits with a small share of global shares.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: BRB Treasury auctions (364-day bill 11.00%) and term deposits 7.44%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits, Treasury bills and global shares, between the safe and equity base cases.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: higher share in Treasury bills and global shares with continued franc depreciation.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension amount was found; no official source on such a scheme could be read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No eligibility rules for a non-contributory old-age pension were found.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code text on end-of-service or severance benefits could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.note: Rules of the INSS contributory pension (private employees) could not be read: the INSS site did not respond and ILO/SSA country profiles refused access.

fdr_3m.note: The BRB publishes one average for all term deposits (7.44%, end-December 2025).

fdr_1y.note: The BRB publishes one average for all term deposits (7.44%, end-December 2025).

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found in BRB statistics.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned weekly by the BRB for the Treasury (13, 26 and 52 weeks); mostly bought by banks.

tbond_5y.note: 2 to 10-year bonds are auctioned by the BRB; 5-year issues are occasional.

tbond_10y.note: 10-year bonds are auctioned most weeks by the BRB.

equity_fund.note: No stock exchange or retail investment funds operating in Burundi were found.

gold.note: No retail market for investment gold bars or coins was found; gold trading and export are regulated by the BRB.

centralBank.name: Banque de la République du Burundi (BRB)

insuranceRegulator.name: Agence de Régulation et de Contrôle des Assurances (ARCA)
insuranceRegulator.note: Site unavailable when checked on 31 October 2026.

pensionScheme.name: Institut National de Sécurité Sociale (INSS), pensions for private-sector employees
pensionScheme.note: Site did not respond when checked on 31 October 2026; civil servants are covered by the Office National des Pensions et Risques Professionnels (ONPR, https://www.onpr.bi/).

statistics.name: Institut National de la Statistique du Burundi (INSBU, formerly ISTEEBU)
